summary.zh: 早王朝王陵核心区；Petrie《最早诸王朝王陵》报告第一王朝王陵发掘。Wilkinson 综述其在国家形成与王权丧葬建筑中的地位。
summary.en: Early Dynastic royal cemetery core; Petrie’s Royal Tombs reports First Dynasty royal tombs. Wilkinson synthesizes Abydos in state formation and royal mortuary architecture.

editorial.notes: Key sites § Abydos (Umm el-Qaab); coordinates not asserted in civ MD.
